summary_1line: Deities describe meritorious rituals—offerings to ants, cows, moon—and declare that hearing or reciting these sacred duties grants purification and spiritual merit.

image_candidates.scene_text: Devotees place raw sugar and rice upon a flower-strewn ant-hill at sunset as the sky glows in the west.
A worshipper feeds gentle cows at dawn while sacred bulls stand beneath Shiva’s banner bearing the bull emblem.
Under a bright full moon, a devotee lifts a copper vessel of honey-mixed food as an offering to the rising moon.
